semantics.definition: The shape four base tiles leave open where they meet two by two: four points and four sides curved inward, each a tile’s rounded corner, as thick as a tile, matte in Eidos’s secondary colour. Active, it glows in that colour, with a soft light on the tiles round it. Your words, 21 and 23 Nov.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one astroid every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Fill the middle where four base tiles meet, lying matte or glowing; be the drone’s body.

state.default: lying matte, in the secondary colour
state.active: glowing in its own colour, a soft light of that colour on the tiles round it

measure.radius: how far its four points reach from its middle: the base tile’s corner radius
measure.thickness: how thick it is: the base tile’s thickness
